description: Fetch the full Recall Canary record for a single U.S. federal recall, FSIS public health alert or CPSC safety warning (`record_kind`), given the agency and slug returned by search_recalls. Includes the hazard description, the affected product list with lot codes and UPCs, the recommended consumer action, distribution, the Recall Canary page URL to link when citing it (`url`), the agency's own notice (`source_url`), and the firm slug (`firm.slug`, with `firm.page_url` when the firm has a page) for search_recalls' `firm` filter. Also resolves preliminary agency press releases: an orphan, or a linked one that kept its own URL (its recalls in `linked_recalls`). Pass `detail: "brief"` unless you need related records or the timeline. Read-only.

agency.description: Lowercase agency segment from the record URL: a search row's `agency` in lower case (`FDA_IRES` is `fda`). Part of the lookup key, not decoration: a correct slug under the wrong agency is a miss.

detail.description: `full` (the default) or `brief`, which leaves out `related`, `timeline`, `press_releases`, `description`, `story_lead_id`, `story_lead_url` and `advisory_url`.

slug.description: The record slug from its URL, e.g. "acme-foods-peanut-butter". The 26-character ULID id is also accepted and resolves to what its URL shows (for a matched press release, often its recall).

name: get_recall

outputSchema.description: One record. `record_type` says which shape: a canonical agency record (products, timeline, dates, related; `record_kind` says whether it is a recall, alert or warning) or a `preliminary` agency press release (linked_recalls, company and agency dates).

agency.description: Known values: FDA, FDA_IRES, FSIS, CPSC, NHTSA, ADMIN.

ai_generated.description: Provenance: true where the field holds model-written text. Over-attributes on purpose.

category.description: True only for a press release's model-classified category.

animal_product.description: Whom an FDA product is for, from FDA's own signals (its veterinary center's V- recall number, or an Animal & Veterinary, Animal Feed or Pet Food product type), never from product names. `category` stays FDA's (pet food is FOOD). Null otherwise. Do not give an animal product human advice.

category.description: Known values: FOOD, DRUG, BIOLOGIC, DEVICE, COSMETIC, CONSUMER_PRODUCT, VEHICLE, AUTO_EQUIPMENT.

citation.description: How to cite this record: link `page_url` (the Recall Canary page a reader can use) and name `source_url` (the agency's own notice) as the source of record. Also `publisher` and `source_of_record` (the agency's name).

company_product_list.description: The company's own list of the affected products, when the agency notice points to it instead of naming them. A product missing from `identification` may still be recalled: check this list.

consumer_action.description: The "What to do" text. Null on a withdrawn alert. On a CPSC safety warning, CPSC's own Consumer Action (its instructions, not a remedy).

content_changed_at.description: When the published content last changed.

critical_flags.description: NHTSA-only in practice: boolean do_not_drive, park_outside, ota_fixable, undeclared_drug, equipment_only, international. An absent key means the agency did not state the flag. null for a withdrawn (RETRACTED) record.

dates.description: `listed_at` (with `listed_at_basis`), `began_at` (the recall's own start; FDA only), `fda_posted_at`, `ended_at`; `announced_at` is deprecated.

description.description: Full agency description. FSIS: sanitized HTML; others: plain text. Sanitize or escape before display.

countries_all.description: The agency's structured manufacturing-country list (CPSC only), each country once; [] for FDA, FSIS and NHTSA.

country.description: CPSC: the first manufacturing country it lists. FDA: the firm's address country.

page_url.description: /firm/<slug> page, only when that page is indexable.

slug.description: The firm filter value (`firm=` on search_recalls).

html_url.description: Absolute URL of the human-readable page.

identification.description: Page-derived identification: the products and codes the record names. Not a completeness guarantee; `partial` says when the list is incomplete, including when this response cut `products` to 25 (`mcp_truncated.identification_products`).

late.description: Null unless the recall is late: it began more than 184 days before listed_at, or it ended on or before the date its listed_at_basis names.

listed_at.description: The listing date; equals this record's search_recalls row. A recall's is in dates.listed_at.

mcp_truncated.description: Present only when a long list was cut to 25 for this response.

notes.description: Caveats for this record, including the aggregator-lag and not-a-clearance statement.

press_releases.description: Linked agency press releases, as links (`url`, `title`).

product_count.description: The true event scope, which may exceed products.length.

items.description: One affected product. Lot codes and UPCs: one code per element, every code held; `*_omitted` counts the codes the agency notice lists beyond them.

component_also_listed.description: NHTSA only, present when non-empty: another component NHTSA's recall record (api.nhtsa.gov) lists for this product's vehicle beside `component`, NHTSA's text as stated; never on a withdrawn campaign.

gtin.description: The GS1-valid codes of `upc` (a GTIN, or a UDI-DI on a device).

remedy_description.description: The agency's remedy text; on a CPSC safety warning, CPSC's Consumer Action (instructions, not a remedy).

unlisted_since.description: When the agency stopped listing this product (ISO); null while it lists it.

products_truncated.description: True when `product_count` exceeds the length of `products`

reason.description: The agency's own stated reason, one agency text verbatim, never model-written and never two texts joined (FDA: openFDA's current text, or FDA's fuller iRES text that contains it).

record_kind.description: What kind of agency notice a recall record is: `recall`, an FSIS `public_health_alert` or a CPSC `safety_warning`; the last two are not recalls and are never rated. Null on a preliminary record. `record_type` is `recall` on all three; no filter selects by kind.

related.description: Related records, each a ref with `url` and `title`: `same_product`, `same_hazard`, `by_firm`, and `events` (stored relations, at most 20). Pass `detail: "brief"` to leave it out.

remedy_superseded.description: A later CPSC safety warning says this recall's remedy is no longer being provided: its page and its sentence that says so (verbatim, or null). `consumer_action` is then that warning's Consumer Action unless an operator pinned one. Null otherwise.

risk.description: The agency rating as the page shows it (for example "High risk" for an FDA Class I recall). Null where the page shows no risk line.

explained_at.description: Absolute URL of the page that explains the rating.

warnings.description: NHTSA only, present when the campaign carries both warnings: ["Do not drive", "Park outside"].

snapshot_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC response-generation time, second precision. First key on purpose.

source_recall_id.description: Agency key; a CPSC one can be stale.

source_url.description: The agency's own notice: the source of record. Name it beside `url` when you cite the record.

story_lead_id.description: Set on a later record of a recall story; the lead it belongs to.

title.description: Agency-published title. Never model-written. Show `display_title` when it is present; it is the plain title the page prints.

url.description: The Recall Canary page for this record (absolute, canonical): the plain-language page a reader can use. Link this when you cite the record.

title: Get one recall by agency and slug
